culpritSource.quote: The real culprit is Yuko Oyodo. Ayaka and Yuko had a plan to kill Mai Fukamoto, but it was a setup by Yuko to kill Ayaka. She wanted to get revenge on Ayaka because Ayaka stole the man she loved and later dumped him, causing him to suicide. Later at the end of the episode, Conan, Sonoko and Ran are promoting the seal toy.

summary.en:
Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are in the shopping mall, where they meet model girls promoting a new toy seal. Later, they heard a scream, and found one of the models is dead.

Accident? or Murder?

Location: Beika shopping mall storage room

suspects: Mina Komoro, Mai Fukamoto, and Yuko Oyodo
